acceptanceCriteria: A SubagentStart adapter event returns a bounded packet as additionalContext, or a named degradation code, and never blocks the spawn.
The host-adapter spec gains a requirement with a stable ID traced to a fixture test, and compatibility.json records the new surface.
A recorded trial compares `corvint surprise` for subagents with and without the packet on at least one frozen task set.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner's request to research Corvint integrations with large productivity gains. The Claude Code plugin registers SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse (Edit|Write|NotebookEdit), Stop, PreCompact, PostCompact and SessionEnd (`integrations/claude-code/plugins/corvint/hooks/hooks.json`), but not SubagentStart. SubagentStart cannot block, its input carries `agent_prompt`, and it accepts `additionalContext` (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks). Every Explore or worker subagent therefore re-reads the repository. Proposal: map SubagentStart to a bounded `corvint context --task <agent_prompt>` packet through the existing `corvint adapter claude-code` path, advisory only, with the same budget and degradation codes as user-prompt. Any productivity gain is a hypothesis until measured; `corvint surprise` and `corvint necessity` supply the measure.
title: hosts: inject a task-context packet at Claude Code `SubagentStart` so subagents do not start cold
